title: "Climate Stress Testing (CST) Toolbox"
format: html
subtitle: "Automated bottom-up climate vulnerability assessments at basin-level"
toc: false
number-sections: false
---

The toolbox helps users understand climate vulnerability and assess the robustness of water systems under
an uncertain future. It combines global data, hydrological modelling and weather generation to explore
how river basins respond to a broad range of temperature and precipitation changes.

Results, interpreted alongside climate projections, support first-order screening, helping users identify
vulnerabilities, explore adaptation needs and prioritize further investigation.

## Start here

1. [Install](guide/install.qmd) and check external-data access.
2. [Run the example](guide/quick-start.md) and find its output tables.
3. Follow [Creating a project](guide/new-case.qmd) to set up your own assessment.
4. [Run or resume workflows](guide/running.md) and [interpret the outputs](guide/outputs.md).

The [User Guide](guide/quick-start.qmd) explains how to run an assessment and inspect its results.
The [Technical Manual](technical-manual/overview.qmd) describes the methods, data, configuration and
interpretation of toolbox results. [Methodology](scientific-approach/overview.qmd) explains the
bottom-up assessment approach and how climate stress testing informs water-system decisions.
